title: Suricata IDS Detection
story: A server is generating suspicious traffic. Students must deploy Suricata, inspect alerts, and identify malicious activity.

tasks.title: Start Suricata
tasks.description: Start the Suricata IDS service and confirm it is running.
tasks.hint: Use systemctl or service controls to start suricata.

tasks.title: Analyze fast.log
tasks.description: Open the Suricata fast.log file and inspect recent alerts.

tasks.title: Trigger IDS Alert
tasks.description: Generate traffic that causes Suricata to emit an alert.
tasks.hint: Use a known test alert pattern or suspicious traffic sample.

tasks.title: Explain Suricata Rule
tasks.description: Explain what the Suricata rule detects and why it indicates malicious behavior.
tasks.hint: Mention the signature, traffic pattern, and security impact.

tasks.title: Detect Malicious Traffic
tasks.description: Identify the malicious traffic source or signature from the alert data.
tasks.hint: Look for the alert signature and source address in fast.log.
